content: OpenVLA-7b requires ~21 GB VRAM (bfloat16). Colab T4=15 GB — insufficient. A100 Colab (40 GB) works. Pi0 base requires 40 GB A100; openpi (open-source reimplementation) achieves ~15 Hz on 24 GB GPU. Critical: MUJOCO_GL=egl must be set BEFORE importing mujoco — setting after import has no effect. GLFW fails in headless Colab. OSMesa is software-only (no GPU). OpenVLA requires PyTorch 2.2.0, transformers 4.40.1, flash-attn 2.5.5 pinned — later versions have breaking changes. Bitsandbytes 8-bit quantization causes torch.compiler import failure on PyTorch 2.2.
